title: UPS transfer to maintenance bypass (demo training panel)
author: Wilmer Angel
disclaimer: Simplified demonstration procedure. The breakers used are a residential training panel that represents a maintenance bypass cabinet; they do not control any UPS. Not a manufacturer or site MOP. Real transfers must follow the UPS OEM manual, the site MOP, interlock (key) requirements and a qualified two-person rule. Battery isolation, inverter shutdown and downstream checks are intentionally omitted.
basis: Steps 1 to 3 follow the sequence common to the reviewed OEM manuals: UPS to static bypass, close MBB, verify, then open MIB. Steps 4 and 5 (bypass input before rectifier input) follow the Schneider Galaxy VX order; other manufacturers use a different isolation order.
references: Vertiv Liebert APM operation manual, section 10.4 Switching the UPS from Normal Operation to Maintenance Bypass
Vertiv Liebert 1000kVA / 610 user manual, Maintenance Bypass Load Transfers
Schneider Electric Galaxy VX Operation 990-5452, Shut Down Single System from Normal to Maintenance Bypass Operation
Eaton 93PR Installation and Operation Manual, 6.7 Transfer the UPS from Double Conversion Mode to Maintenance Bypass Mode
panel_note: Labels are on tape next to each breaker. Handle ON direction is toward the center of the panel: to the right for the left column, to the left for the right column. CLOSED means handle ON; OPEN means handle OFF. Circuit numbers follow the panel directory: odd numbers in the left column, even numbers in the right column. Circuits not in this MOP are not evaluated.

panel.label: Q5
panel.position: left column, 1st single 15 A below the quad

panel.label: Q9
panel.represents: Maintenance isolation breaker, UPS output to load (MIB)

panel.label: BYP
panel.represents: UPS ON STATIC BYPASS status (CLOSED = on bypass)

steps.action: From the UPS control panel, transfer the UPS to internal static bypass. Confirm the ON BYPASS status.
steps.hazard_if_wrong: If the UPS is not on static bypass, closing Q8 parallels the inverter output with the bypass source.

steps.action: Close the maintenance bypass breaker Q8.
steps.hazard_if_wrong: If Q8 is not closed, opening Q9 in the next step drops the critical load.

steps.action: Open the maintenance isolation breaker Q9. The load is now fed through maintenance bypass Q8.
steps.hazard_if_wrong: If Q9 remains closed, the UPS output is still connected to the load and cannot be isolated.

steps.action: Open the static bypass input breaker Q7. The UPS is no longer on static bypass.
steps.hazard_if_wrong: If Q7 remains closed, the UPS bypass path stays energized.

steps.action: Open the rectifier input breaker Q5. The UPS is isolated and the load remains on maintenance bypass.
steps.hazard_if_wrong: If Q5 remains closed, the UPS rectifier is still energized.

label_scheme: Tape labels follow the official panel directory: Q1 to Q9 are directory positions 1 to 9, BYP is position 10. Only Q5, Q7, Q8, Q9 and BYP are operated in this MOP.
distractor_note: Distractors are never operated and never scored. They stay ON for the whole procedure.
